bible.title: The Ward at Riversbend
bible.kernel: A sanctuary pays a company to fetch a ward raised under another man's name, and the ward must choose between home and the life he grew into.

cast.name: Hodierne
cast.who: steward of the riverside sanctuary and keeper of its pledges.
cast.want: to have the sanctuary's ward returned to the riverside sanctuary

cast.name: Barothlas Windrow
cast.who: riverward tavernkeeper who has long kept a foundling as his own helper.
cast.want: to keep the child as his steward at the inn

cast.name: Delven Fairweather
cast.who: a foundling raised under another man's name, playful and eager for honest work.
cast.want: to find honest work beyond the inn

bible.situation: Hodierne's riverside sanctuary sponsored a foundling years ago as a ward. Barothlas Windrow took the child in and raised the child at his inn under Barothlas's name. The child, Delven Fairweather, learned kitchen and steward work at the inn and later left to seek work near Thornhollow. Hodierne wants the ward returned to serve as the sanctuary's sworn witness. Barothlas will refuse to hand the child over without a price.
bible.goal: to recover the sanctuary's ward and return that ward to the riverside sanctuary
arc: Search Hodierne's riverside sanctuary garden for signs of the ward the client named → yields: a child's wool cuff stamped with Barothlas Windrow's inn mark
Take the cuff to Barothlas Windrow's inn and question him about the cuff → yields: Barothlas admits he raised the child and gives a carved wooden spoon with the child's maker mark

Follow the spoon's maker mark along the old elf road to Thornhollow and search the ruin's kitchen → yields: Delven Fairweather found at Thornhollow, who agrees to return to Hodierne at the riverside sanctuary at dusk
Bring Delven to Hodierne's riverside sanctuary at dusk for the handover, where Barothlas stands to block the transfer and must be overcome
tensions: Barothlas refuses to part with the child and will fight or demand a price
Delven may choose independence over the sanctuary's pledge
Travel along the old elf road to Thornhollow risks weather and lonely thieves
openDirections: If the company fails or Delven refuses the sanctuary, Hodierne must find another sworn witness or forfeit the rites to the river guild
bible.stakeIfLost: the sanctuary loses its chartered right to host the river-guild's annual rites because the ward is the sworn witness who seals the charter
bible.arrival: sent a rider ahead and came behind it · named a price before being asked

shipped.title: Search the sanctuary garden
shipped.situation: A steward, Hodierne, sent a rider ahead and came behind it. "If this fails, the sanctuary loses its charter right to host the river-guild's annual rites because the ward is the sworn witness who seals the charter," they say. They want signs of the ward found in the riverside sanctuary garden, the fee is fixed, and what else shakes loose the company keeps. An innkeeper at Windrow Hold means to keep the child as his steward at the inn. They keep a hand flat on the table and say the ward must come home.
shipped.job: Search the riverside sanctuary garden for signs of the ward
